statuses.intro: Maudindo anu otsogola ndi magawo ang'onoang'ono - zomwe aliyense amafunsa (tsiku ndi nthawi, magawo otsogola) wina akasintha chiwongolero chake.
statuses.name: Dzina la Status
statuses.fieldsToShow: Magawo otsogolera kuti awonekere pa fomu yosinthira
statuses.subStatusesHint: Chigawo chilichonse chikhoza kufunsa tsiku ndi nthawi yake ndikuwonjezera magawo ake - omwe akuwonetsedwa pamwamba pa magawo omwe ali pamwambapa.

notifications.intro: Dziwitsani anthu oyenerera pamene otsogolera afika pamalo ake - mwamsanga, kapena nthawi yoikidwiratu lisanafike/litatha tsiku ndi nthawi yomwe yakonzedwa.
notifications.emptyRules: Palibe zidziwitso pano - onjezani imodzi kuti muchenjeze gulu lanu mtsogoleri akafika paudindo.
notifications.deleteConfirm: Chotsani chidziwitso " {{name}} "? Zikumbutso zomwe zikuyembekezera zachotsedwa.
notifications.testPrompt: Tumizani mayeso a chidziwitsochi kwa inu nokha (mu-pulogalamu) pogwiritsa ntchito ID yotsogolera ?
notifications.headersInvalid: Mitu Webhook iyenera kukhala yovomerezeka JSON , mwachitsanzo {"Authorization": "Bearer xyz"}
notifications.name: Dzina
notifications.noScheduleWarning: Izi sizimafunsa tsiku ndi nthawi, chifukwa chake chidziwitso cha "nthawi isanachitike/pa/pambuyo pake" sichingawombe.
notifications.noScheduleFix: Yatsani Funsani tsiku ndi nthawi yake pansi pa Status & Sub-Status, kapena tumizani Pompopompo.
notifications.inactiveNever: Osagwiritsa ntchito salandira zidziwitso, ngakhale atasankhidwa.
notifications.emailHint: Imelo imapita ku adilesi ya imelo ya wolandira aliyense ndipo imafunikira SMTP kukhazikitsidwa pa seva (backend/.env); mpaka ma imelo omwe amatumizidwa amalowetsedwa ngati kudumpha.
